verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.withpersona.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section, including the tip to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown. A versioned llms.txt (2025-12-08) indexes doc pages with Markdown links and short descriptions, and every cited docs page is served as `.md`. Missing for 10: no evidence of a single-file llms-full.txt bundle and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
